title: Unveiled Glory (Monday Evening Message)
description:
Scripture Text: 2 Corinthians 3:18

Opening evening message laying the foundation of vertical transformation and beholding the glory of the Lord.

title: A Call to Awakening: A Study of Elijah and Elisha
description:
Scripture Texts: 2 Kings 2:1–15; Isaiah 52:1

Morning intensive teaching on spiritual succession, mantle reception, and awakening campus altars.

title: BSF and My Life in the Baptist Church (Orientation)
description: Afternoon session focusing on Churchmanship, Baptist identity, and student commitment to the local church body.

title: Destined for Glory (Anointing Night)
description:
Scripture Text: 1 Samuel 16:11–13

Anointing service for divine selection, empowerment, and Kingdom alignment.

title: Who May Ascend? (Wednesday Evening Message)
description:
Scripture Text: Psalm 24:3–10

General conference arrival evening message on clean hands, pure hearts, and ascending the hill of the Lord.

title: The Greater Generation (Thursday Morning Teaching)
description:
Scripture Texts: John 14:12; Haggai 2:9

Expository teaching on greater works, spiritual maturity, and the glory of the present house.

title: Raising Kingdom Influencers in Academics and Career
description:
Scripture Text: Matthew 5:13–16

Academic & Career Seminar empowering students and young professionals for salt-and-light influence in academia and secular spaces.

title: Greater Glory (Thursday Refreshing Night)
description:
Scripture Texts: Haggai 2:9; Isaiah 52:1–7

All-night revival gathering featuring song ministration by Min. Rebecca Olowookere and the main conference theme address by Rev'd. Ebenezer Osundele.

title: Arise: Pure & Undefiled (Friday Relationship Seminar)
description:
Scripture Texts: Psalm 25:3–4; Isaiah 52:1; Isaiah 60:1

Practical seminar on godly relationships, purity, courtship, and building Christian homes.

title: Refreshing @40 Anniversary Celebration
description: Commemorative 40th anniversary celebration service, heritage remembrance, and anniversary message.

title: Song Ministration & Closing Charge
description: Final night of worship and global commissioning with song ministrations by Ebunolamisings and the Oladosu Twins, culminating in the closing charge by Mr. Sunday Oguntola.
